Typography

round(16 x 1.25^n): 13, 16, 20, 25, 31, 39px. Weights body 400, label 500, heading 650.

headline.md 39/48 650Page and section titles.
headline.sm 31/40 650Page and section titles.
title.lg 25/36 650Card, panel and group titles.
numeric.lg 25/36 650Key numbers: balances, KPIs.
body.lg 20/28 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 20/28 650Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 16/24 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 16/24 500Button and control labels.
code.md 16/24 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 16/24 650Table headers, field-group titles.
numeric.md 16/24 400Amounts and table figures: tabular digits line up in columns; right-align numeric columns.
body.sm 13/20 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 13/20 500Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 13/20 500Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 13/20 400Inline values, dense code rows.
